newsitem.title: USA: Toshiba Corp unit names president.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba Corp unit names president.

text.p: Toshiba America Inc, the holding company for Toshiba Corp operations in the United States, said Friday it names Shunichi Yamashita as vice chairman and president and Atsutoshi Nishida also as vice chairman.
The appointments will be effective as of July 1.
Yamashita joined Toshiba Corp in 1963 and most recently was general manager of Toshiba's legal affairs division.
Nishida, who joined Toshiba in 1975, will also serve as president of Toshiba America Information Systems Inc, the company said in a press release.

Most recently, Nishida was general manger of Toshiba's personal computer division. He is expected to be elected vice president and director of Toshiba Corp at the company's shareholder meeting on June 27, the company said.
